t: Léonie Watson, "Design like you give a damn: Practical accessibility for web pros" at W3Conf 2013

q.x: with a web page using correct markup, a good screen reader interface, and some practice, they can navigate and consume information much faster than we can visually.

desc: W3Conf is W3C's an­nual confer­ence for web pro­fes­sion­als. If you are a web devel­op­er or designer want­ing to hear the lat­est news on HTML5, CSS, the open web platform and your place in it, come join us!
